forms.detail: DEA Diversion Control Division (March 2026): most licit products are tablets and capsules, with some injectables and syrups. EUDA drug profile: tablets, capsules, injectables (for example diazepam, lorazepam, midazolam) and suppositories.

forms.form: New benzodiazepines sold as new psychoactive substances (Europe)
forms.detail: EMCDDA 2021: marketed as 'research chemicals', often as highly pure, crystalline powders, and also sold as tablets, capsules or blotters. Seizures have included tablets, capsules, blotters, e-liquids for vaping and other liquids. Falsified medicines appear as tablets, sometimes in blister packs, imitating Valium (diazepam) or Xanax (alprazolam).

DEA Diversion Control Division (United States, May 2026): sold as powder, as tablets and spiked onto blotter paper, and bought online labelled as a research chemical not intended for human consumption. EMCDDA 2021: large-scale illicit production of etizolam tablets in Scotland in 2017-2018, and a seizure of etizolam tablets from India by Spanish customs in February 2019.
DEA Diversion Control Division (United States, April 2026): usually found as pills whose markings mimic Xanax and Klonopin; also bought online as a research chemical.
DEA Diversion Control Division (United States, April 2026): identified in 'PEZ-like pills or tablets'.
